Backstop + Diagnosis Completed

Error-triggered stop gates and artifact-only diagnosis for small-model tool agents

Python · Ollama (Qwen2.5 / Llama3.1 / Gemma4 / Ministral) · BFCL · Holm-Bonferroni & Wilson Bounds

Done 1Failed 3

Architectural overview

Problem & architectural thesis

Small tool-calling agents frequently give up right after a tool error instead of correcting the bad argument or missing prerequisite. Blindly forcing retries adds wrong actions; Backstop tests whether deterministic error+schema diagnosis turns runtime failure artifacts into safe recovery.

Control flow

  1. ProposeAgent Premature Stop After Tool Error

    Multi-turn tool agent (7B–9B) receives a runtime tool error and attempts to terminate the turn unresolved.

  3. Deterministic GateStop Gate + Artifact-Only diagnose()

    Parses only the tool error string and active tool schema (zero ground truth) to decide whether an actionable repair hint exists.

  5. Commit / RefuseRefuse with Hint or Permit Stop (D_only)

    Refuses premature stop with the deterministic diagnostic hint or permits clean termination; scored on H1/H2 lift plus G1/G2 harm ceilings.

Key tradeoff & failure mode

Stage 1 bare stop refusals tripped both harm guardrails. Confirmatory diagnosis (N=843, qwen2.5:7b) lifted recovery from 16.0% to 42.1% and whole-task success by +5.7 pp with clean G1 (4.0%), but failed G2 (2.579x post-fork wrong actions) because of blind fallback turns. Dropping blind fallbacks (D_only, exploratory) eliminated regressions (49 rescued, 0 lost) and cut wrong actions 73–79%, yet gains did not transfer uniformly across families (null on ministral-3:8b, redundant on gemma4:e4b) and an external tau2-bench smoke gate failed below the zero-tool floor.

What it is

  • A preregistered error-triggered stop gate on BFCL multi-turn (llama3.1:8b and qwen2.5:7b) lifted per-turn recovery after an unresolved tool error, but failed to raise task success significantly and tripped both harm guardrails (registered verdict: guardrail failed — gain not clean). #backstop-stage1-stop-gate
  • A preregistered artifact-only diagnosis (built from error text and tool schemas, zero ground truth) lifted qwen2.5:7b error recovery from 16.0% to 42.1% and whole-task success by +5.7 percentage points with clean G1, but failed the post-fork wrong-action guardrail G2 (registered verdict: Gain not clean). #backstop-diagnosis-confirmatory
  • Exploratory cross-family testing showed artifact-only diagnosis is uneven across 7–9B model families and did not generalize over plain refusal on either gemma4:e4b (which already self-recovers on plain refusal) or ministral-3:8b (which failed to convert D's hints); an external tau2-bench smoke gate failed below a zero-tool floor and was dropped. #backstop-diagnosis-cross-family
  • In an exploratory follow-up, dropping the blind N2 fallback (D_only: refuse a stop only when diagnose() produces a hint) preserved 100% of task-success gains across all three models while eliminating regressions at N=843/250 and cutting post-fork wrong actions by 73–79%, though gains remained uneven across families. #backstop-diagnosis-hint-only

What was measured1 entry

MEASURED LINKED #backstop-diagnosis-hint-only as of 2026-11-24

In an exploratory follow-up, dropping the blind N2 fallback (D_only: refuse a stop only when diagnose() produces a hint) preserved 100% of task-success gains across all three models while eliminating regressions at N=843/250 and cutting post-fork wrong actions by 73–79%, though gains remained uneven across families.

Does not showProspective out-of-sample confirmation (D_only was designed from post-hoc G2 findings and evaluated on the same test sets, not unseen seeds). Under the strict registered G2 bootstrap 95th-percentile rule, D_only still misses 1.744 (p95 2.111 on qwen; inf on gemma4) because matching N0 on >80% of tasks shrinks the post-fork denominator. Ministral remains null.

What each entry does not show

  • #backstop-diagnosis-hint-only Prospective out-of-sample confirmation (D_only was designed from post-hoc G2 findings and evaluated on the same test sets, not unseen seeds). Under the strict registered G2 bootstrap 95th-percentile rule, D_only still misses 1.744 (p95 2.111 on qwen; inf on gemma4) because matching N0 on >80% of tasks shrinks the post-fork denominator. Ministral remains null.
  • #backstop-diagnosis-confirmatory Generalization across model families (failed H1 on ministral-3:8b and gemma4:e4b), transfer outside BFCL's eight simulated apps, or silent-failure coverage. Confirmatory N was reduced from 1,000 to 843 after a harness integer-serialization bug at task 844; the labelled secondary N=1,000 set matches every conclusion.
  • #backstop-diagnosis-cross-family Confirmatory cross-family bounds (exploratory, N=250, single seed) or behavior on external benchmarks where small models clear a zero-tool floor. Five older 7–9B models also failed the tool-calling smoke gate before selection.
  • #backstop-stage1-stop-gate That every small model fails for the same reason (follow-up probes split llama as execution-limited and qwen as diagnosis-limited), or behavior on silent errors that return no tool error.

Weaknesses and negative results3 entries

NEGATIVE-RESULT LINKED #backstop-diagnosis-confirmatory as of 2026-11-24

A preregistered artifact-only diagnosis (built from error text and tool schemas, zero ground truth) lifted qwen2.5:7b error recovery from 16.0% to 42.1% and whole-task success by +5.7 percentage points with clean G1, but failed the post-fork wrong-action guardrail G2 (registered verdict: Gain not clean).

Does not showGeneralization across model families (failed H1 on ministral-3:8b and gemma4:e4b), transfer outside BFCL's eight simulated apps, or silent-failure coverage. Confirmatory N was reduced from 1,000 to 843 after a harness integer-serialization bug at task 844; the labelled secondary N=1,000 set matches every conclusion.

Exploratory cross-family testing showed artifact-only diagnosis is uneven across 7–9B model families and did not generalize over plain refusal on either gemma4:e4b (which already self-recovers on plain refusal) or ministral-3:8b (which failed to convert D's hints); an external tau2-bench smoke gate failed below a zero-tool floor and was dropped.

Open questions

  • Does the hint-only gate (D_only) preserve qwen2.5:7b's zero-regression lift on completely unseen seeds under a preregistered harm guardrail? from #backstop-diagnosis-hint-only
    Would resolve it: A new preregistered run on untouched seeds (e.g., extension/pool_ext.jsonl tasks 251–500) paired with a call-normalized or risk-weighted guardrail.
  • Does error+schema diagnosis transfer outside BFCL's eight simulated apps, and does it remain useful as stronger small models self-recover on bare refusals? from #backstop-diagnosis-cross-family
    Would resolve it: An external tool-use benchmark where unmodified 7–9B models clear a zero-tool floor, tested across multiple model families.
